formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (s : Fin n → Bool) (T T' : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ → PEqualNP.Core.IsLiftFixedPoint G C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover G T → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover (G.deleteEdges (((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C) : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))) T' → ((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C)).card + T.card ≤ ((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.Core.coneSet n C)).card + (PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).card + T'.card
plain_statement: G is a bipartite graph with no 4-cycle. C has AND and OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, so it reads only earlier wires, computes the edge function of G (true exactly when both ends of some edge are true), and is a lift fixed point (the implicant lift applies nowhere). Let U be the union of the cones of the maximal cores of C, D the edges accepted by some maximal core, mc the number of maximal cores, tau(G) the least size of a vertex cover of G and tau(G - D) that of G with the edges of D removed. Then |D| + tau(G) <= |U| + mc + tau(G - D).
title: Core-cover bound: at a lift fixed point of a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for a 4-cycle-free bipartite edge function, |D| + tau(G) <= |U| + mc + tau(G - D)
